title: Molecular interaction of antiviral drug penciclovir with DNA and HSA insights from experimental and docking studies.
authors: Abd Ali AAkool, Waleed; Kashanian, Soheila; Hadidi, Saba
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验与分子对接研究抗病毒药物喷昔洛韦与DNA及人血清白蛋白的相互作用，虽涉及药物-DNA结合模式但非TF-DNA体系，方法以对接为主，可借鉴其小分子-DNA互作建模思路。
abstract: One approach to accelerate the availability of new cancer drugs is to test drugs approved for other conditions as anticancer agents. During recent decades, penciclovir (PNV) has been frequently utilized as a potent antiviral drug, in particular against infections caused by herpes viruses. Many antivirals interact with DNA and change their expression level, so determining the binding mode is of great importance. In our laboratory, we have focused our attention to design improved drugs that target cellular DNA, to understand the mechanism of action at the molecular level, and also to investigate the effect of antiviral drugs as anticancer agents. The results of ct-DNA-PNV interactions at physiological pH using fluorescence spectroscopy, UV-visible absorption spectroscopy, and molecular modeling reveal this drug binds well to ct-DNA through groove binding. The circular dichroism measurements displayed that PNV caused a slight change in the DNA structure which affirmed that the binding of PNV with the DNA occurs through the groove mode. Besides, multi-spectroscopic and molecular docking were used to evaluate how PNV interacts with human serum albumin under physiological conditions. The findings of fluorescence quenching suggested that static quenching was involved in the spontaneous development of HSA-PNV complex through hydrophobic force. The docking simulation results validated the findings of spectroscopic techniques.
abstract_zh: 加速新抗癌药物可用性的一种途径是将已批准用于其他病症的药物作为抗癌剂进行测试。近几十年来，喷昔洛韦（PNV）常被用作一种强效抗病毒药物，特别是针对由疱疹病毒引起的感染。许多抗病毒药物与DNA相互作用并改变其表达水平，因此确定结合模式至关重要。在我们的实验室中，我们专注于设计靶向细胞DNA的改良药物，以在分子水平上理解作用机制，并研究抗病毒药物作为抗癌剂的效果。在生理pH条件下，通过荧光光谱法、紫外-可见吸收光谱法和分子建模对ct-DNA-PNV相互作用的研究结果表明，该药物通过沟槽结合方式与ct-DNA良好结合。圆二色谱测量显示，PNV引起DNA结构轻微变化，这证实了PNV与DNA的结合是通过沟槽模式发生的。此外，采用多光谱法和分子对接评估了PNV在生理条件下与人血清白蛋白的相互作用。荧光猝灭的结果表明，静态猝灭参与了HSA-PNV复合物通过疏水力的自发形成。对接模拟结果验证了光谱技术所得发现。
